title: Agent chain of command
description: ~/.local/state/agents/org.json, written by `agents org` and `agents lead` (dotfiles/agents/lib/org.py). The proxy, Tom's top-level session, is implicit and is the root; a node whose parent is missing hangs under it.

priority.description: Tom's domain priority order, first wins; the spawn capacity gate reserves headroom for the first domain.

id.description: Unique node name; sessions see it as AGENT_ORG_NAME.

session.description: Claude session id or name, or Codex thread id.

brief.description: Absolute path of the node's brief.

status_file.description: Absolute path of the node's status file.

budget.description: Remaining delegation budget; always below the parent's.

state.description: active: the workstream is in Tom's current goal or agenda.

pid.description: Launcher process; a dead pid on an active node means it died.

died.description: Set by the launcher exit hook when an active node's session ended.

args.description: Extra provider arguments the launcher reuses on restart.
